title.narrative: 1972 Convention: Building resilience to climate change and disaster risk at WHS in Peru

description.narrative:
The project aims to contribute to the reduction of disaster risks in 13 World heritage Sites in Peru.
By strengthening the capacities of over 60 managers and technical teams at 13 World Heritage Sites in Peru, the project will improve the comprehensive management of these Sites, specifically in the processes of prevention and preparation for risks and disasters intensified by global climate change that could directly impact Peru's cultural and natural heritage. Likewise, The project will be jointly designed with the Ministry of Culture and national counterparts to develop a tool that will enable the Peruvian State to better prepare for potential risks. The cultural sector has committed to adapting this tool as part of the national cultural policy
The project will contribute to the implementation of the Action Plan for Latin America and the Caribbean (2023-2029), specifically to the fulfillment of strategic objective 2 on strengthening effective management for the conservation and promotion of World Heritage in the region, through actions such as the development and implementation of disaster/risk prevention plans, as well as climate adaptation and mitigation plans, and Strategic Objective 3 on developing capacities to adopt innovative approaches to the conservation, management and promotion of World Heritage.
